verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev documents an official CLI. It has a dev command that runs a local server to execute tasks, and the changelog adds CLI commands for projects, runs and environment management. Community users independently praise the Dev mode workflow. Missing for 10: a detailed command reference in the evidence, and evidence of AI-agent-friendly CLI behavior (machine-readable output, non-interactive auth).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: This runs a server on your machine that can execute Trigger.dev tasks
New CLI commands for projects, runs, and env management
Also want to call out the Dev mode: it's an absolute gem, makes testing and iterating so much smoother than anything else I've tried.
